description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {R}{G}{W}{U}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
